title: Z1DA--VANJHCS Demolition and Abatement IDIQ East Orange and Lyons
description: General Information 2.1 Location Work performed under this scope shall be for and conducted within the VA New Jersey Health Care System (VANJHCS) at the East Orange VA Medical Center, located at 385 Tremont Ave, East Orange, NJ 07018, and Lyons VA Medical Center, located at 151 Knollcroft Rd, Lyons NJ 07939. 2.2 Purpose This Statement of Work (SOW) is for an IDC for demolition and abatement efforts supporting construction and repair services at VANJHCS Medical Centers. These services shall be provided on an as needed basis, for a five-year term. VANJHCS has various sized projects that require a Contractor to perform the demolition and abatement portion of this work necessary to accomplish this goal. The minimum value for this IDC is $10,000.00 with a maximum dollar value of $2,000,000.00. 2.3 Scope A description of all individual demolition and abatement tasks covered under this IDC contract can be found in the contract Line Items. The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, supervision, safety, quality control and management necessary to fulfill the requirements of task orders issued by the Government under this contract. All work completed under this contract shall comply with applicable Infection Control requirements and the New Jersey Administrative CodeA (NJAC) 5:23-8, Asbestos Hazard Abatement Subcode, and NJAC 12:120 governing asbestos abatement, licensing, and permitting requirements. Additional administrative and management related requirements are described in Section 3: Requirements. Material testing and air monitoring services required while performing asbestos removal services shall be provided by the VANJHCS at no cost to the contractor. No work outside the defined Statement of Work (SOW) shall be performed without written authorization from the Contracting Officer (CO). Unauthorized work may be deemed Unauthorized Commitment (UAC) and may not be reimbursed. The Contractor shall be responsible for all means and methods and shall ensure all work is performed in a safe, compliant, and professional manner.

title: Building 215 Clean Room HEPA Filter Replacement
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) BUILDING 215 ADVANCED MEASUREMENT LABORATORY (AML) CLEANROOM REPAIR AND HEPA FILTER REPLACEMENT Solicitation/Reference No.: 1333ND26RNB190014 1. PURPOSE OF THIS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is conducting market research pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 and FAR 15.201 to obtain industry feedback concerning the scope, schedule, phasing, cleanroom outage requirements, technical and performance risks, and estimated construction cost associated with the Building 215 Advanced Measurement Laboratory (AML) Cleanroom Repair and HEPA Filter Replacement project. NIST previously solicited this requirement under Solicitation No. 1333ND26RNB190014. NIST did not receive an acceptable offer under that solicitation. NIST is therefore reassessing the requirement and acquisition approach before determining whether and how to resolicit the project. NIST is particularly interested in identifying aspects of the requirement that may materially affect industry participation, constructability, schedule feasibility, pricing, risk, or the ability of contractors to submit competitive proposals. Industry is encouraged to provide candid feedback and to identify recommended changes that could improve constructability, competition, schedule feasibility, cost certainty, and overall project execution while continuing to meet NIST�s mission and cleanroom operational requirements. 2. RFI / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE THIS RFI IS ISSUED SOLELY FOR INFORMATION AND ACQUISITION PLANNING PURPOSES. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP), INVITATION FOR BID (IFB), REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ), OR OTHER SOLICITATION. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on responses to this RFI. Responses will be treated as information only and shall not be construed as offers or proposals that can be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting information in response to this RFI or for participating in any follow-up discussions. This RFI does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government�s ultimate acquisition approach. Respondents are advised that information submitted in response to this RFI may be used by NIST in developing or revising the acquisition strategy, statement of work, specifications, schedule, phasing requirements, outage requirements, Government cost estimate, and future solicitation. Respondents should clearly identify and mark any proprietary, confidential, or commercially sensitive information contained in their responses. Respondents should avoid including proprietary information unless necessary to provide a meaningful response. 3. PROJECT BACKGROUND The project involves repair and modernization work within the Building 215 Advanced Measurement Laboratory cleanroom located at the NIST Gaithersburg Campus. The AML cleanroom encompasses approximately 1,800 square meters and includes approximately 750 square meters of Class 100 cleanroom space. The facility supports sensitive NIST research activities and contains specialized and, in some instances, irreplaceable scientific equipment. The project generally includes, but is not limited to: Replacement of approximately 1,200 terminal supply HEPA filters; Repair and/or modification of HEPA filter connections; Testing, balancing, certification, and recertification of affected HEPA filters and cleanroom spaces; Replacement of approximately 70 variable air volume (VAV) terminal units; Replacement of approximately 54 airflow monitoring devices; Installation of approximately 32 exhaust air control valves; Modification and repair of associated ductwork; Rebalancing of associated air-handling and exhaust systems; Verification and repair, as required, of existing capped ductwork; Controls-related work; Cleaning, testing, balancing, commissioning, and cleanroom certification associated with each affected area; and Protection of existing cleanroom spaces, research operations, and sensitive scientific equipment throughout construction. Detailed project drawings, specifications, and/or relevant portions of the previously issued solicitation may be attached to this RFI or otherwise made available through SAM.gov for purposes of industry review. 4. CURRENT PHASING AND OUTAGE CONCEPT NIST�s previous acquisition strategy was developed to minimize disruption to ongoing research operations by performing the work through phased cleanroom outages rather than shutting down the entire cleanroom for the duration of construction. The previous requirement contemplated 19 construction phases consisting of 18 Critical Cleanroom Outage Phases and one Non-Critical Phase. For each Critical Cleanroom Outage Phase, the contemplated outage period was approximately nine calendar days, generally structured as follows: Outage/construction activities begin at approximately 7:00 p.m. on Friday; Work proceeds continuously, including 24-hour-per-day/seven-day-per-week operations, as necessary; Construction, startup, testing, balancing, cleaning, commissioning, and applicable cleanroom certification are completed during the outage period; and The affected cleanroom area is required to achieve Ready for Re-Occupancy by approximately 7:00 a.m. on the second following Monday. Ready for Re-Occupancy generally means that required construction, startup, testing, balancing, cleaning, commissioning, and applicable cleanroom certification have been completed; the affected area is operationally capable of supporting its intended use without material restriction; and no deficiencies remain that materially impair safe occupancy or cleanroom operations. The previous requirement also contemplated maintaining unaffected cleanroom bays in operation to the maximum extent practicable and included the possibility of limited additional weekend outages affecting larger portions of the cleanroom. NIST recognizes that these operational constraints may significantly affect contractor staffing, sequencing, subcontractor availability, construction risk, pricing, and schedule feasibility. NIST is specifically seeking industry feedback concerning these requirements. 5. INFORMATION REQUESTED FROM INDUSTRY Respondents are requested to review the project information provided with this RFI and address the following topics. Respondents are not required to answer every question; however, detailed and candid responses are encouraged. A. Outage Feasibility and Constraint Identification Critical Path Bottlenecks: Identify the specific trade activities that present the highest risk to achieving a 9-day bay outage window. Realistic Outage Duration: Based on your experience in occupied nanofabrication facilities, what is a realistic, achievable calendar-day duration to complete a single cleanroom bay/module from shutdown to final recertification? Risk & Impact Analysis: Explain how the current 24-hour, 9-day limit impacts project risk, labor density, safety, quality assurance, and total cost (including risk contingencies for $8,000/day liquidated damages). Phasing & Mock-Up Alternatives: Would executing a "mock-up bay" or initial trial phase establish a viable baseline for subsequent production bays? B. Construction Cost Estimate Based on the information provided, what is industry�s rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) estimated construction cost for the complete project? Respondents may provide either a specific estimated amount or a reasonable estimated range. To the extent practicable, please identify the approximate portion of the ROM estimate attributable to: Direct construction work; HVAC/HEPA/VAV work; Controls work; Testing and balancing; Commissioning and cleanroom certification; Premium time, shift work, or 24/7 outage staffing; General conditions; Phasing and temporary protection; Contingency/risk allowance; and Other signi

Code 2: Assembly (or set or kit) not furnished - Used following detail parts. Code 3: Part not furnished separately - Use assembly. Code 4: Part redesigned - Old and new parts are completely interchangeable. Code 5: Part redesigned - New part replaces old. Old part cannot replace new. Code 6: Part redesigned - Parts not interchangeable. 3.4 Mercury Free - The material supplied under this contract/purchase order is intended for use on submarines/surface ships and therefore shall contain no metallic mercury and shall be free from mercury contamination. Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys. Stainless steels, nickel, and copper alloys are widely used in reactor plants and other submarine/surface ship systems. Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. It is evident that grave consequences could result from small amounts of mercury vapor present in an unreplenished submarine/surface ship atmosphere. 4. title: 25ME522 - Contrat-cadre pour l'acquisition et l'installation de lifts dans plusieurs centres de maintenance
description:
L’objet du marché consiste en une offre pour un contrat cadre concernant la fourniture, l’installation et la mise en service de neuf systèmes de levage hydraulique adaptés à l’entretien de véhicules de grande capacité, tels que des minibus, bus standard (10 m et 12 m), bus articulés (18 m) et trolleybus articulés (18m). Sur les plans et dans les documents d’appel d’offres, ces neuf lifts seront installés sur trois sites :

  • Cernier, avec deux lifts : 

o   Remplacement d’un lift pour le lavage (Lift L, Cernier)

o   Remplacement d’un lift pour l'atelier (Lift A, Cernier)

  • Neuchâtel, avec trois lifts :

o   Un nouveau lift pour l'atelier (non existant) (Lift C, Neuchâtel)

o   Remplacement de deux lifts pour l'atelier (Lifts A et B, Neuchâtel)

  • La Chaux-de-fonds, avec quatre lifts :

o   Remplacement de trois lifts pour l’atelier (Lifts A, B, C, La Chaux-de-Fonds)

o   Remplacement d’un lift pour le lavage (Lift L, La Chaux-de-Fonds)


Les lifts doivent être tous identiques, excepté les lifts pour les lavages, le nombre de colonnes mobiles ou fixes, les longueurs et les profondeurs (en fonction des différentes tailles de fosses). Ces trois derniers éléments seront choisis par l’adjudicateur au moment de la commande. Les lifts dédiés au lavage devront, en plus, répondre à des spécifications supplémentaires liées au lavage et au traitement de châssis.


Le choix des différentes configurations des lifts (profondeurs différentes, longueurs différentes, nombre de colonnes mobiles et fixes) pour chaque emplacement sera fait au moment de la commande d’entente avec le fournisseur. Le prix évalué sera fait selon une estimation du nombre de lift de chaque configuration fournis par l’adjudicateur dans l’annexe C.5. Les dimensions des fosses sont données dans l’appel d’offres. Le soumissionnaire est libre de fournir une ou plusieurs dimensions de lifts, tant que ceux-ci peuvent être installés dans les fosses respectives.

Les lifts qui remplacent un ancien lift seront intégrés dans des fosses en béton déjà existantes. Pour le nouveau lift (lift C) installé à Neuchâtel, il n'y a pas encore de fosse. La création de la fosse sera faite par une entreprise externe à ce marché public.


L’actuel Lift C situé à un autre endroit dans le dépôt sera mis hors service. Pour ce dernier comme pour les autres lifts, il est demandé en option F un prix pour le démontage des lifts. Tout doit être inclus excepté le démontage de ce qui est scellé dans le béton et la vidange de l’huile hydraulique.

title: Germany – Design and execution of research and development – Analyse der Verteilung von Vermögen in Deutschland
description: Das Bundesministerium für Arbeit und Soziales (BMAS) beabsichtigt, ein Forschungsprojekt zur „Analyse der Verteilung von Vermögen in Deutschland“ durchführen zu lassen. Im Rahmen dieses Forschungsprojekts soll die im 6. Armuts- und Reichtumsbericht vorgenommene Analyse der Vermögensverteilung und ihre Entwicklung im Zeitverlauf fortgesetzt werden. Die aktuellen Entwicklungstrends in der Verteilung der Vermögensbestände privater Haushalte und Personen und ihre Ursachen sollen auf Basis der Einkommens- und Verbrauchsstichprobe (EVS) der Jahre 2008, 2013, 2018 und – sobald verfügbar – 2023, der Vermögensbilanzen des Sozio-oekonomischen Panels (SOEP) der Jahre 2007, 2012, 2017 und – sobald verfügbar – 2019 und 2024 sowie der Studie Private Haushalte und ihre Finanzen (PHF) der Bundesbank dargestellt werden. Die Analyse soll Auswertungen sowie den Abgleich mit anderen Datenquellen, insbesondere den Volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnungen und den Statistiken der Bundesbank beinhalten. Dabei soll auch die statistische Untererfassung von Hochvermögenden und deren Folgen für die Analyse der Vermögensverteilung berücksichtigt werden. Außerdem soll untersucht werden, welchen Einfluss Vermögensübertragungen auf das Verteilungsergebnis haben. Bitte beachten Sie die beigefügten Vergabeunterlagen.

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Planungsleistungen der Freianlage DGH Schwabenheim, Lph 5-9
description: Die Ortsgemeinde Schwabenheim beabsichtigt im Zusammenhang mit dem Neubau des Dorfgemeinschaftshauses "Greiffenklauer Hof" die weitere Planung und Umsetzung der zugehörigen Freianlagen. Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens sind die Planungsleistungen für Freianlagen gemäß Teil 3 Abschnitt 2 HOAI. Die Vergabe erfolgt im Rahmen eines EU-weiten Vergabeverfahrens. Für die Freianlagen liegt bereits eine Planung aus den vorangegangenen Leistungsphasen vor. Grundlage der weiteren Bearbeitung ist insbesondere die im März 2022 vom Rat beschlossene Planvariante. Diese sieht einen Veranstaltungshof im Bereich vor dem Bacchuskeller sowie die funktionale und gestalterische Einbindung der Freiflächen zwischen dem Dorfgemeinschaftshaus, den vorhandenen Gebäudeteilen und den angrenzenden öffentlichen Verkehrsflächen vor. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Planung ist die Bewältigung der vorhandenen unterschiedlichen Geländehöhen und Erschließungssituationen. Nach der bisherigen Planung ist eine barrierefreie Erschließung von der Bachstraße und von der Schulstraße sowie eine barrierefreie Verbindung von der Bachstraße zum Hof vorgesehen. Eine barrierefreie Erschließung unmittelbar vom Veranstaltungshof war in der vom Rat beschlossenen Planvariante nicht vorgesehen. Bei der weiteren Planung sind insbesondere die vorhandene Bebauung und die bestehenden Kellerstrukturen, darunter der Bacchuskeller sowie weitere Kellerbereiche, die Anschlüsse an den Neubau und die umgebenden Straßenräume sowie die hieraus resultierenden Höhen- und Zugangssituationen zu berücksichtigen. Die vorliegenden Planunterlagen weisen unter anderem mehrere vorhandene Kellerbereiche aus, die bei der weiteren Planung zu berücksichtigen sind. Die Freianlagen sollen sowohl der Erschließung des Dorfgemeinschaftshauses als auch als Aufenthalts- und Veranstaltungsflächen dienen. Neben den befestigten Platz-, Wege- und Erschließungsflächen sind die erforderlichen Höhenübergänge, Einbauten, Vegetationsflächen und sonstigen Freiraumelemente planerisch weiterzuentwickeln und bis zur Ausführung zu begleiten. Leistungsumfang Gegenstand der Beauftragung sind die Leistungsphasen 5 bis 9 des Leistungsbildes Freianlagen gemäß § 39 HOAI HOAI i.V.m. Anlage 11 HOAI. Der Auftragnehmer hat die vorhandenen Planungsunterlagen zu übernehmen und auf dieser Grundlage die Planung ab Leistungsphase 5 fortzuführen. Die Leistungen umfassen damit insbesondere die ausführungsreife Durcharbeitung der bestehenden Planung, die Vorbereitung und Begleitung der Vergabe der ausführenden Leistungen, die Überwachung der fachgerechten Umsetzung der Freianlagen sowie die anschließende Objektbetreuung.

title: Malta – Relocation services – Provision of Relocation, Move Support, Warehousing and Distribution Services for the European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA) premises in Malta Lot1: Relocation and Move Support Services Malta Lot2: Warehousing and Distribution Services Malt
description: The European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA) requires the provision of Relocation and Move Support Services (Lot 1) and Warehousing and Distribution Services (Lot 2) in Malta as described in Part 2 – Technical Specifications. The services are necessary to support the Agency’s operational, administrative and logistical activities, including internal relocations within EUAA premises and relocations between different EUAA premises in Malta., the handling and transport of furniture, office equipment, archives and other assets, as well as the storage and distribution of palletised and non-palletised goods. The procurement has been structured into two Lots in order to ensure that relocation and move support services, and warehousing and distribution services, can be managed independently while remaining under the same procurement procedure. Under Lot 1, the required services include, inter alia: • Supply of packaging materials and crate rental/delivery services, with due regard to environmental performance requirements • Organisation, coordination and execution of relocation and move support activities, including dismantling and reassembly of furniture and equipment • Provision of qualified personnel (e.g. Move Manager, Foreman, porters and specialised staff), including, where requested, permanent porter services during EUAA working hours • Provision of appropriate vehicles and handling equipment suitable for small, medium and large-scale relocation operations Under Lot 2, the services include: • Secure storage of palletised and non-palletised goods, calculated in accordance with the Financial Tender Form • Inbound handling operations (receiving, unloading, palletisation, labelling, inspection and placement into storage) • Outbound handling operations (picking, packing, reconfiguration and loading) • Transportation services for inbound and outbound movements, including dedicated vehicles and after-hours transport, where required Given the dynamic and occasionally urgent nature of EUAA’s operations, the Agency must ensure access to reliable, flexible and professional service providers capable of responding to ad-hoc requests, short notice operations and fluctuating volumes. The availability of these services is essential to guarantee business continuity, safeguard EUAA assets, ensure compliance with health and safety and environmental requirements, and maintain operational efficiency across all EUAA premises in Malta.

title: Advancing HIV & AIDS Epidemic Control (AHEC) Project
description: This acquisition is conducted under the authority of 40 U.S.C. 113, as implemented by AIDAR 706.302- 70(b)(3)(ii), and substantiated by the Expedited Procedures Package (EPP). AIDAR 706.302-70(b)(3) and FAR 6.303-2 allows USAID (now the Department of State) to limit competition when compliance with full and open competition procedures would impair foreign assistance objectives. More specifically, AIDAR 706.302-70(b)(3)(ii) states that full and open competition is not required for: �Awards for countries, regions, projects, or programs for which the Administration of USAID makes a formal written determination with supporting findings (D&F), see Attachment 1 to this J&A, that compliance with full and open competition procedures would impair foreign assistance programs.� The authority for the D&F under the HIV/AIDS EPP is based on 40 U.S.C. 113(e)(2) and 48 CFR 706.302-70. Tab 1 of the EPP procedures, specifically the D&F, is provided as Attachment 1 to this J&A.The EPP specifically authorizes the use of AIDAR 706.302-70(b)(3)(ii) for contract actions, stating "You have the authority to extend the EPP under the following: for contracts, Section 706.302-70(b)(3)(ii) of USAID�s Acquisition Regulation (AIDAR), Impairment of Foreign Aid Programs; for assistance awards, ADS Chapter 303.3.6.5, Restrictions to Eligibility; and for the source-and-nationality waiver, Section 228.31 of Title 22 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR)." The current EPP is effective from January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2029, and was approved by the USAID Administrator. Although the EPP is specific to USAID, a memorandum of understanding between USAID and the Department of State delegates authority to DOS to carry out applicable PEPFAR programming under USAID procedures and regulations. Accordingly, this justification relies on AIDAR 706.302-70 as the basis for limiting competition, as proceeding with full and open competition at this stage would risk impairing the effective implementation of a critical foreign assistance program

title: West Valley Development Project (WVDP) Technical Assistance Contract (TAC)
description: JUSTIFICATION FOR EXCEPTION TO FAIR OPPORTUNITY Project Name: West Valley Development Project (WVDP) Technical Assistance Contract (TAC) Estimated Cost/Price of the Task Order: Approximately $5M Authority: FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C) Type Determination: Individual I. Contracting Activity United States Department of Energy, Environmental Management Consolidated Business Center (EMCBC), Office of Contracting, Contracting Officer, Jennifer K. M. Splitt. II. Nature and/or Description of the Action Being Processed The EMCBC is proposing to issue a logical follow-on task order for the West Valley Demonstration Project (WVDP) for necessary technical, administrative, and database management services. The type of services are the same as the services described in the performance work statement for the master IDIQ contract, 89303322DEM000084, and currently being performed on the current WVDP TAC Task Order, 89303323FEM400321 (hereinafter the �Current WVDP TAC Task Order�). The proposed scope of the follow-on will also be initiated upon expiration of the period of performance of the current Task Order and the master IDIQ contract, and is well within the maximum ordering quantity of the master IDIQ contract. The current West Valley TAC Task Order was competitively awarded under the EM Field Site Technical Assistance Contracts (hereinafter �Site TACs�) Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract. Seven (7) contractors were awarded under the Site TACs IDIQ. The objective of the multiple award IDIQ is to provide technical assistance for DOE�s Field Sites supported by EMCBC. These sites include WVDP, EM Los Alamos Field Office (EM-LA), and the Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action (UMTRA) Project, among other EM Field Sites. The scope of the Technical Assistance Contracts for EM Field Sites includes safeguards and security, emergency management, quality assurance, project integration, data management, administrative support, regulatory/environmental compliance, nuclear safety, waste management, records/information management, engineering, training, property management, public affairs, cost estimating, and technical editing. The Site TACs IDIQ has a five (5) year ordering period, with a period of performance from September 20, 2022 to September 19, 2027. Under the chosen IDIQ contract type, the authority exists to issue logical follow-on task orders. The FAR and the Site TACs IDIQ (H.41 Task Ordering Procedure) provide statutory and contractual exceptions to the Fair Opportunity process. Among these exceptions is the issuance of a Task Order on a sole-source basis in the interest of economy and efficiency as a logical follow-on to an order already issued under the IDIQ contract, provided that all awardees were given a fair opportunity to be considered for the original WVDP Task Order. All eligible EM Site TACs contract holders were provided a fair opportunity to compete for this work. Before issuance of the current WVDP TAC Task Order, all seven holders of Site TACs contracts were provided a Request for Task Order Proposal on November 4, 2022 with a requested proposal submission deadline of November 20, 2022. Six (6) contractors submitted proposals in response to the solicitation and FPM AECOM JV1 was selected. FPM AECOM JV1�s management approach and transition of work approach and capability combined with a realistic and reasonable cost and price resulted in the best value determination in its favor. The Ordering procedures of the Site TACs IDIQ (clause H.41) included statutory exceptions to the Fair Opportunity Process allowing DOE to issue a logical follow-on task order on a sole source basis in the interest of economy and efficiency. Thus, contract provisions put all eligible Site TACs IDIQ contractors on notice at the time the Current WVDP TAC Task Order was solicited that DOE could issue the awardee a sole-source logical follow-on task order. The Current WVDP TAC Task Order is valued at approximately $9M and the period of performance is from 1/23/2023 to 09/12/2026. Under the Current WVDP TAC Task Order, DOE is currently utilizing services related to project controls, safeguards and security, quality assurance, administrative support, and emergency management. FPM AECOM JV1�s performance in providing the required services to date has been rated Very Good to Exceptional, reflecting excellent quality, cost control and management. FPM AECOM JV1 has built effective working relationships with stakeholders and has been very flexible, able to respond quickly and positively to changes and direction from DOE. If DOE transitions to a new contractor, it can expect to experience increases in costs, quality variances and management risks during the time it would take for the new contractor to learn to perform at least as well as FPM AECOM JV1 is now performing. Additionally, DOE expends at least two years of time and resources when it procures such services competitively. Through its several years of high-quality performance, FPM AECOM JV1 has gained valuable institutional knowledge and experience to continue performing well. The work at the WVDP will benefit from moving forward towards a finished state rather than experiencing the delays and possible missteps or even dangers that would result from introducing a less experienced contractor to the project work. Consequently, DOE expects to achieve significant benefits in economy and efficiencies by issuing a logical follow-on task order to FPM AECOM JV1 for the WVDP TAC Task Order. Considering the benefits to the WVDP of continued performance by FPM AECOM JV1 and the costs in time and resources to re-compete the Task Order, issuing FPM AECOM JV1 a follow-on task order on a sole-source basis will be the most economic and efficient method to meet the requirements. III. Description of the Supplies/Services Required To Meet the Agency�s Needs (including the estimated value) SOURCE SELECTION INFORMATION�see FAR 2.101 and 3.104 The scope of the proposed follow-on task order is to continue technical assistance work including project controls, safeguards and security, quality assurance, nuclear safety, administrative support, and emergency management. The application of this contract, with the skillset listed above is the most efficient application of technical and administrative support requirements if/when DOE needs immediate support with highly competent and qualified individuals with the required expertise. IV. Authority Permitting a Fair Opportunity Exception FAR 16.505(b)(1)(i) requires the Contracting Officer to provide each awardee under a multiple award contract, a fair opportunity to be considered for each order exceeding the micro-purchase threshold ($15,000) unless a statutory exception applies. The specific exception that precludes the fair opportunity process for this acquisition is FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C): The order must be issued on a sole-source basis in the interest of economy and efficiency because it is a logical follow-on to an order already issued under the contract, provided that all awardees were given a fair opportunity to be considered for the original order. The new WVDP TAC Task Order is a logical follow-on in terms of the anticipated scope of the, period of performance, and value as all will be comparable to the current Task Order that FPM AECOM JV1 is successfully performing (see discussion in Sections III and VI). The IDIQ contracts offer DOE access to a pre-qualified pool of 12 Small Businesses and allow for streamlined task order awards. However, with the fair opportunity requirement having been met in the original order, conducting another IDIQ contract competition for virtually the same requirements would be needless, especially when the IDIQ contract provisions allow DOE to take the more prudent course of action in negotiating a justified follow-on Task Order to FPM AECOM JV1. title: ADVANCE NOTICE TO INDUSTRY: INTENT TO ISSUE CHALLENGE STATEMENT for the United States Space Command (USSPACECOM) Command and Control Facility (C2F): Design Build Contractor (DBC) Acquisition
description: INDUSTRY ANNOUNCEMENT: INTENT TO ISSUE CHALLENGE STATEMENT for the United States Space Command (USSPACECOM) Command and Control Facility (C2F): Design Build Contractor (DBC) Acquisition Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) seeks a partner to serve as the DBC responsible for the design, construction, fit out, commissioning, and accreditation of the USSPACECOM C2F. The selected contractor will be responsible for providing a mission-ready facility by December 2031. The DBC will be responsible for design and construction of the facility, including all associated Command, Control, Communication, and Computer Information Technology (C4IT) and Fixtures, Furniture and Equipment (FF&E), and must be skilled in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE). Additionally, the DBC will be responsible for providing Construction Surveillance Technicians to ensure construction meets ICD-705 standards in collaboration with the AFCEC team�s SSMs. This integrated, holistic approach is a significant departure from prior MILCON construction norms; our intent is to provide qualified design-builders time to establish expanded partnerships in advance of the Challenge Statement release. The government will accept questions related to this release. Please submit all questions on the GoColosseum Marketplace under the Industry Announcement titled above. The Government reserves the right to respond to questions at its discretion and may not provide responses to all questions submitted 1. Summary of Overall Objective: AFCEC seeks an innovative, highly capable, and experienced partner to serve as the DBC for design and construction of a new C2F warfighting platform at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama. This mission critical facility, and its supporting data center, is required to support approximately 1,800 personnel and cost approximately $4B to design, build, fit-out, commission, accredit, install FF&E. The C2F will incorporate Radio Frequency (RF) shielding, High-Altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP) protection, Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) / Special Access Program (SAP) construction, and redundant and resilient infrastructure. The project will be delivered using a collaborative delivery methodology under the Design Build Institute of America (DBIA) Design Build Done Right framework. This challenge and the resulting agreement are issued pursuant to the Other Transaction Authority (OTA) for military construction projects under 10 U.S.C. � 2808a. This effort is intended to reduce traditional Military Construction (MILCON) delivery timelines by approximately 50%, which the prospective partners should be able to embrace. USSPACECOM completed a Planning Charette Report in June 2026. AFCEC is in the process of hiring an Owner�s Advisor (OA) to support them on the Project Delivery Team (PDT). The DBC will integrate with the established PDT to help AFCEC, their OA, and the USSPACECOM PMO deliver this facility faster, smarter, and with higher mission assurance than any previous Air Force MILCON effort. The Design Builder will be expected to provide innovative approaches and leverage industry standards to take advantage of the OTA authorities and flexibility outside of traditional FAR-based construction to reduce time and cost. Eligibility Open to U.S.- based organizations that have demonstrated success as the DBC on complex Mega Projects of this size, scale, and complexity. Organizations must be able to show expertise in design, construction, C4IT, and FF&E integration. Respondents must meet bonding requirements for the entire project amount Respondents must possess a Top Secret (TS) Facility Security Clearance; AFCEC intends for a small number of key personnel to obtain the requisite USSPACECOM SCI read-ins to support facility design, IT design, and portions of IT installation. Additionally, CSTs will be required to hold TS/SCI clearance Respondents must be Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 compliant or actively pursuing certification. Performance will involve the storage, processing, and transmission of Controlled Unclassified (CUI) per 32 C.F.R. � 170.3 Respondents must register on https://gocolosseum.org to submit Selection Criteria Selection will be largely qualification based. Additional criteria will be provided in the Challenge Statement. Timeline The following timeline is provided for planning purposes only and is subject to change. 15 October 2026: Challenge Statement Released on ONIX Marketplace 15 December 2026: Challenge Statement Responses Due

description: ***NOAA'S ACQUISITION & GRANTS OFFICE, EASTERN ACQUISITION DIVISION-NORFOLK, NATIONAL OCEAN SERVICE (NOS) CENTER FOR OPERATIONAL OCEANOGRAPHIC PRODUCTS AND SERVICES (CO-OPS) NEGOTIATED, ON A SOLE SOURCE BASIS, UNDER AUTHORITY OF RFO FAR 12.102(a), WITH IN-SITU INC. OUT OF FORT COLLINS, CO FOR AQUA TROLL SENSORS AND PARTS THAT ARE ON THEIR GSA CONTRACT. ***THE SOLE SOURCE DETERMINATION IS BASED ON THE NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION'S (NOAA) REQUIREMENT THAT THE AQUA TROLLS SENSORS ARE UNIQUE TO THE WORK PERFORMED; NO ALTERNATIVE INSTRUMENT HAS BEEN FOUND TO MEET THE SPECIFICATIONS REQUIRED. THE IN-SITU AQUA TROLL 200 WAS APPROVED FOR USE IN CO-OPS OBSERVING SYSTEMS FOR CONDUCTIVITY AND TEMPERATURE SENSING AFTER A THOROUGH TEST AND EVALUATION OF MULTIPLE SENSORS FROM SEVERAL VENDORS. THESE TESTS EXAMINED QUALITY OF DATA, SENSOR COMPATIBILITY WITH THE CO-OPS SYSTEMS, SENSOR RELIABILITY AND ACCURACY, AND OVER-ALL COST OF THE EQUIPMENT (INCLUDING INSTALLATION REQUIREMENTS, ANNUAL OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE, AND INITIAL PROCUREMENT). THE IN-SITU AQUA TROLL 200 LEVEL SENSOR WAS SELECTED BASED ON ITS DATA RETURN RELIABILITY, MINIMAL INSTALLATION REQUIREMENTS, AND EASE OF INTEGRATION INTO THE CO-OPS SUITE OF STANDARDIZED SENSORS AND EQUIPMENT. THE UNIT IS THE MOST RELIABLE, AFFORDABLE, AND EXPANDABLE OF THE MULTIPLE SENSORS TESTED, AND IS COMPATIBLE WITH CO OPS� DATA MANAGEMENT PROTOCOLS AND VALIDATION USED IN THE PORTS DATA MANAGEMENT COLLECTION AND DISSEMINATION. THIS PURCHASE IS TO SUPPORT MAINTENANCE EFFORTS AT STATIONS WITHIN THE CO-OPS PORTS NETWORKS THOUGH OUT THE UNITED STATES AND TO MAINTAIN THE EMERGENCY RESPONSE CURBY SYSTEMS THAT CO-OPS AND OR&R MAINTAIN TO RESPOND TO EVENTS IN THE GULF OF AMERICA REGION. IMPLEMENTING A DIFFERENT SENSOR WILL RESULT IN ADDITIONAL COST AND RESOURCES AND WILL AFFECT THE CONTINUOUS OPERATION OF THESE SYSTEMS. IN ADDITION, THERE WILL BE RESULTING DELAYS FOR TESTING, TRAINING, AND PURCHASE OF SUPPORT EQUIPMENT. UNDER THE CURRENT CO-OPS OPERATING SYSTEM ANY ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING EQUIPMENT THAT HAS NOT PREVIOUSLY BEEN APPROVED MUST BE SUBJECTED TO A SERIES OF TESTS TO ENSURE THE QUALITY OF THE DATA AND THE DURABILITY OF THE EQUIPMENT FOR THE INTENDED USE. THESE TESTS USUALLY INCLUDE BENCH TESTING USING CONTROLLED CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL MEASUREMENT, CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENTAL TESTING TO CHECK RELIABILITY UNDER DIFFERENT CONDITIONS, AND LONG-TERM COMPARISON TESTING WITH ACCEPTED EQUIPMENT AT MULTIPLE REAL-WORLD LOCATIONS. THESE TESTS AND THE ANALYSIS OF THE RESULTING DATA TAKE A LARGE AMOUNT OF TIME, MONEY AND RESOURCES TO CONDUCT. IN-SITU INC. IS THE SOLE GSA CONTRACT HOLDER WITH THE AQUA TROLL SENSORS ON THEIR GSA CONTRACT. NO OTHER VENDORS WERE FOUND ON GSA WHEN SEARCHING AQUA TROLL SENSORS.

description: La Communauté d’agglomération d’Épinal s’est constituée en centrale d’achat pour offrir aux acheteurs soumis au Code de la Commande Publique, et ayant leur siège social sur le territoire de l’agglomération, un dispositif permettant de répondre aux objectifs de simplification de l’acte d’achat, de sécurisation juridique et d’optimisation des dépenses. Ainsi, la Centrale d’achat assure le rôle d’intermédiaire en application de l’article L.2113-2, 2° du code de la commande publique pour tout acheteur implanté sur le territoire de l’agglomération et assume, à cet effet, la responsabilité du déroulement des procédures et de leur légalité. La liste des adhérents prenant part à la présente consultation est jointe en annexe 1 de l’acte d’engagement du présent marché. Pour la réalisation de l’objet de ce marché : • la centrale d’achat, en qualité de coordonnatrice, est l’acheteur chargé de la préparation, la passation, la signature et la notification de ce marché et des éventuels avenants associés ; • chaque Adhérent Participant est chargé, quant à lui, d’exécuter le marché pour ce qui le concerne. Les Adhérents Participants ont décidé de s’impliquer dans une opération d’autoconsommation collective étendue au sens de l’article 1bis de l’arrêté du 21 novembre 2019 fixant le critère de proximité géographique de l'autoconsommation collective étendue répondant aux critères cumulatifs suivants : • l'un des producteurs ou des consommateurs participants est une commune ou un EPCI à fiscalité propre ; • l'ensemble des producteurs et des consommateurs participants sont des organismes publics ou privés exerçant une mission de service public ou des sociétés d'économie mixtes locales mentionnées à l'article L. 1522-1 du CGCT et leurs filiales ; • les points de soutirage et d'injection sont situés exclusivement dans le ressort géographique de l'établissement public de coopération intercommunale à fiscalité propre participant au projet ou auquel adhèrent la ou les communes participant au projet ; • par dérogation, la puissance cumulée des installations de production des projets répondants aux critères cumulatifs de cette dérogation est inférieure à 10MW. Le présent marché a pour objet l’approvisionnement en électricité d’origine renouvelable des points de livraison des Adhérents Participants , incluant les prestations ci-dessous : • l’approvisionnement non exclusif en électricité d’origine renouvelable des points de livraison des Adhérents Participants, • la gestion et la certification des garanties de capacité et des garanties d’origine associées à ces productions, • la mission de responsable d’équilibre associée aux injections d’électricité du ou des actifs de production conformément à l’article L. 321-15 du code de l’énergie ; • les conditions de l’injection, sur le réseau public de distribution exploité par le Gestionnaire du Réseau de Distribution (GRD) Enedis, d’électricité produite par le Producteur du ou des actifs de production. Le présent marché prend effet à compter de sa notification au Producteur Titulaire et jusqu’au 31 décembre 2037 inclus.

Im Rahmen der Gesamtleister-Submission ist ein Projektvorschlag sowie das verbindliche Angebot dazu gemäss den Anforderungen der FZAG und der Rega zu erstellen. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

Sous peine de nullité, les soumissionnaires devront proposer une offre de prix dont le montant est inférieur à 1.200.000 € TVA comprise pour chaque scénario ; déduction faite du montant de la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € TVA comprise. La mise en œuvre d’un autre scénario que le scénario privilégié pourrait dès lors être envisagé pour l’une ou l’autre édition. Le pouvoir adjudicateur tient à signaler que l’édition 2030 coïncidera avec le bicentenaire de la Belgique.

title: Belgium – Survey services – ECOHYDROLOGISCHE STUDIE KIKBEEK en SBZ MECHELSE HEIDE
description: Aanleiding voor de opstart van de ecohydrologische studie zijn de stabiliteitsproblemen in de plas Kikbeek, waardoor de peilstijgingen in functie van bereiken van de instandhoudingsdoelstellingen momenteel niet kunnen doorgaan. Om te onderzoeken wat de effecten zijn van hogere plaspeilen (dan de huidige) in de Kikbeekgroeve op de omliggende grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties is voorwerp van de ecohydrologische studie. Bijkomend wordt onderzocht welke aanvullende maatregelen voor vernatting in het habitatrichtlijngebied de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeekvallei, Neerharerheide en Asbeek noodzakelijk zijn om tot een klimaatrobuust systeem te komen. Doel van de studie is het onderzoek naar de impact op grondwaterstanden en de randvoorwaarden vanuit ecologie door peilstijgingen van de plas Kikbeek en van hydrologische herstelmaatregelen in het de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeek, Neerharerheide en Asbeek. Dit moet leiden tot het maximaliseren van het herstel en de instandhouding van de grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties. Doelstelling is te komen tot klimaatrobuust systeemherstel, zonder de kritieke infrastructuur (zoals de autosnelweg E314) en de stabiliteit van de groeve Berg en de Kikbeekplas op lange termijn te hypothekeren. De opmaak van hydrologische en ecologische modelvoorspellingen moeten dienen om scenario’s voor peilstijging in de plas Kikbeek te onderzoeken en de ontwikkeling van natte natuur in het habitatrichtlijngebied van de Mechelse Heide uit te werken en te evalueren.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – N8 / Lungern Nord – Giswil Süd: Baulos 21 Trassee und Kunstbauten Nord
description: Im Bereich zwischen dem Südportal des bestehenden Tunnels Giswil und dem neuen Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (separate, bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 19) wird die Strasseninfrastruktur erweitert, damit künftig National- und Kantonsstrasse getrennt über zwei separate Trassees geführt werden können. Die bestehende Buochholzbrücke wird nach Eröffnung des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl für die Nationalstrasse genutzt. Für die Kantonsstrasse wird parallel zur bestehenden Brücke eine neue Strassenbrücke erstellt (separate bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 20). Im vorliegenden Baulos 21 werden die Leistungen für den Lückenschluss zwischen dem Bereich Griffeldossen/Buochholz (Baulos 20) und Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. Die Leistungen umfassen Trasseearbeiten für National- und Kantonsstrasse mit Stützbauwerken sowie einer SABA, einem PW, Geländemodellierungen im Bereich Marchgraben, Wasserbauarbeiten sowie kleinere Kunstbauten. Mit der vorliegenden Beschaffung werden Leistungen für Baumeisterarbeiten für die nachfolgend beschriebenen Hauptarbeiten beschafft: Strassenbau und Werkleitungsbau ------------------------------------------ Neubau Nationalstrasse auf ca. 500 m Länge (insgesamt rund 7'500 m2 Fläche) inkl. ¾-Anschluss Giswil Süd sowie Strassenumbau bestehende Brünigstrasse auf ca. 400 m Länge (insgesamt rund 4'000 m2 Fläche) und Neubau Flurstrassen. Jeweils inkl. Unterbau, Entwässerung Belag und Markierung sowie diverse Werkleitungsumlegungen, -provisorien und -neubauten (u.a. neue Löschwasserleitung für Tunnel Kaiserstuhl). Dazu werden im Perimeter die neue SABA Schwendiboden und das Stapelbecken Nordportal gebaut (Baugrubensicherung mit Rühl- und Nagelwand). Ergänzend werden mit diesem Baulos die Leistungen für den Deckbelagsbau (ca. 16'000 m2) und Markierung (2.1 km Länge) des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. description: Le présent marché porte sur l'organisation de quatre éditions (2027, 2028, 2029 et 2030) des festivités données à l’occasion de la fête nationale les 21 juillet, (code CPV 7995200-2, services d'organisation d'événements relevant de l'annexe III de la loi du 17 juin 2016 relative aux marchés publics - services sociaux et autres services spécifiques). Le pouvoir adjudicateur choisit la procédure négociée directe avec publication préalable. Il s’agit d’un marché à prix global (A.R. 18 avril 2017, art. 2, 3°). Sous peine de nullité, les soumissionnaires devront proposer une offre de prix dont le montant est inférieur à 1.200.000 € TVA comprise pour chaque scénario ; déduction faite du montant de la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € TVA comprise. Le montant brut maximum de l’offre ne peut dès lors pas dépasser, par scénario, 1.249.999 €. (TVAC). De ce montant, il faut déduire la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € (TVAC) Le montant net de l’offre ne peut par conséquent pas dépasser, par édition, 1.199.999 € (TVAC). En raison de travaux de grande ampleur qui se dérouleront dans le Parc du Cinquantenaire entre 2027 et 2029, l’événement pourrait être organisé selon deux configurations, à savoir : • Scénario 1, privilégié pour les éditions 2027 et 2030 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Schuman) avec le public autour des jardins à la française et dans le parc du Cinquantenaire. • Scénario 2, privilégié pour les éditions 2028 et 2029 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Mérode) avec le public sur l’esplanade côté Mérode, autour du bassin et dans le prolongement de l’avenue de Tervuren ; Le pouvoir adjudicateur ne maitrise pas le planning du chantier dont il n’est pas le maître d’ouvrage et ne peut dès lors pas garantir, à ce stade, que le planning des travaux sera respecté. La mise en œuvre d’un autre scénario que le scénario privilégié pourrait dès lors être envisagé pour l’une ou l’autre édition. Le pouvoir adjudicateur tient à signaler que l’édition 2030 coïncidera avec le bicentenaire de la Belgique.

title: Belgium – Building completion work – PKEA - Marché 01 - organisation de la partie pharmacie / salle blanche
description: Le présent marché est un marché public mixte ayant pour objet l’organisation, l’aménagement et l’équipement de la partie pharmacie / salle blanche, y compris les locaux techniques associés, au sein de la Klinik St. Josef à Saint-Vith. Il comprend deux lots de travaux et un lot principalement de fournitures. Le marché ne porte pas uniquement sur la création d’un environnement contrôlé de type salle blanche, mais également sur l’aménagement complet de la pharmacie hospitalière concernée, de la salle blanche, de leurs locaux techniques associés, ainsi que des équipements, mobiliers, dispositifs techniques, raccordements, finitions et accessoires nécessaires à leur fonctionnement conforme, sécurisé et opérationnel. Le marché comprend l’ensemble des travaux, fournitures, prestations, sujétions et moyens nécessaires à la réalisation complète et conforme des ouvrages, locaux, installations et équipements décrits dans le présent Cahier spécial des charges, dans les clauses techniques, les plans, le métré récapitulatif et les autres documents du marché. Le marché est divisé en trois lots : Lot 1 – Démolitions : comprenant les travaux préparatoires, les démontages, les démolitions, les évacuations, les protections provisoires et toutes prestations nécessaires à la libération des zones concernées par les travaux. Lot 2 – Parachèvements et techniques : comprenant les travaux de parachèvement, les techniques spéciales, les équipements, le mobilier fixe ou intégré et les dispositifs nécessaires à l’aménagement de la pharmacie, de la salle blanche et de leurs locaux techniques associés. Le lot 2 comprend toutes les prestations d’attente, de réservation, de raccordement, d’adaptation, d’interface et de coordination nécessaires à l’intégration des isolateurs relevant du lot 3, dans les limites précisées par les documents du marché. Lot 3 – Isolateurs : comprenant les études d’exécution, la fourniture, la livraison, la manutention, l’installation, les raccordements propres, le paramétrage, la mise en service, les essais, la qualification, la documentation, la formation, la garantie et la maintenance des isolateurs de préparation pharmaceutique, ainsi que toutes les prestations d’interface nécessaires à leur intégration. Approche performancielle applicable aux lots 2 et 3 : Les prescriptions techniques et les postes des bordereaux relatifs au lot 2 et au lot 3 sont, selon les cas, formulés en termes de performances à atteindre, d’exigences fonctionnelles ou d’une combinaison de celles-ci avec des prescriptions techniques, constructives et normatives. Les exigences minimales, performances, résultats, tolérances, conditions d’exploitation, méthodes de vérification et documents probants sont précisés dans les clauses techniques, les plans, les bordereaux et les autres documents du marché. Pour les lots 2 et 3, le soumissionnaire détermine, dimensionne et inclut dans son offre l’ensemble des études d’exécution, fournitures, équipements, accessoires, interfaces, travaux et prestations accessoires, réglages, essais, contrôles, qualifications, documents et autres moyens nécessaires pour atteindre et démontrer les performances et résultats exigés. Pour le lot 3, cette obligation couvre notamment la conception d’exécution, le dimensionnement, la configuration et l’intégration fonctionnelle des isolateurs ainsi que leur compatibilité avec les installations et performances du lot 2. Les solutions proposées respectent les exigences minimales, les contraintes architecturales et techniques, les normes et réglementations applicables, les règles de l’art ainsi que les conditions d’exploitation propres à une pharmacie hospitalière comprenant un environnement contrôlé et une salle blanche. Les travaux seront exécutés dans un environnement hospitalier en activité. L’adjudicataire devra dès lors tenir compte des contraintes spécifiques liées à la continuité des soins, au maintien de l’activité hospitalière, à la sécurité des patients, du personnel et des visiteurs, à la protection des équipements sensibles, ainsi qu’à la limitation des nuisances, poussières, vibrations, interruptions techniques et risques de contamination. L’ensemble des prestations devra être réalisé conformément aux règles de l’art, aux prescriptions légales et réglementaires applicables, aux normes en vigueur et aux exigences propres aux pharmacies hospitalières et aux environnements contrôlés. La salle blanche et les installations qui concourent à ses performances devront être conformes aux exigences définies par l'AR 30/09/2020 Annexes III guide PICS relative à la bonne préparation des médicaments stériles, telles que précisées dans les clauses techniques du marché, ainsi qu’aux instructions du Pouvoir adjudicateur, des auteurs de projet, du coordinateur sécurité-santé et, le cas échéant, des organismes de contrôle. Lot 3 relatif aux isolateurs : La fourniture, l’installation spécialisée, la mise en service et la qualification propre des isolateurs de préparation pharmaceutique font partie du présent marché au titre du lot 3. Les titulaires des lots 2 et 3 coordonnent les réservations, attentes, alimentations, raccordements, évacuations, interfaces avec le traitement d’air et les autres techniques, adaptations constructives, accès de livraison et de manutention, essais intégrés et opérations de qualification.
